newsitem.title: UK: SEPT BRENT LOADINGS DOWN THREE AT 35.5 CARGOES.
newsitem.headline: SEPT BRENT LOADINGS DOWN THREE AT 35.5 CARGOES.

text.p: The September North Sea Brent crude oil loading programme has been set at the equivalent of 35.5 cargoes, made up of 32 full cargoes and 1.782 million barrels in top-ups, traders said on Thursday.
This compares to an original August programme of 36 full cargoes and 1.213 million barrels in top-ups, equivalent to 38.5 cargoes.
Crude from the Brent and Ninian systems is blended at the Sullom Voe terminal on the Shetland Islands and exported as world benchmark Brent blend.
